summary.text: Frank Bertone is a Republican write-in candidate for Arizona State Senate District 3 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which incumbent Republican John Kavanagh and Democrat Jeff Fortney are also running.

Ballotpedia's campaign finance history for Bertone lists earlier candidacies for the Arizona Corporation Commission in 2024, U.S. House and U.S. Senate in Arizona in 2022, and the New Hampshire House of Representatives in 2018.
